description: The first plot in Figure 4.1 illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," ranges from 0 to 6, indicating the number of epochs during the training process. The y-axis, labeled "WER," ranges from 10 to 70, representing the Word Error Rate percentage. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model configuration: tiny, base, medium, and large, differentiated by color and marker shape. The tiny model, represented by a blue line with square markers, shows a decreasing trend in WER as the number of epochs increases, starting at around 70 and ending near 20. The base model, depicted by a blue line with diamond markers, starts at a WER of approximately 60 and decreases to around 30. The medium model, shown with a green line and circle markers, begins at a WER of about 50 and ends near 20. Lastly, the large model, represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starts at a WER of around 40 and decreases to about 10. Each line shows a general downward trend, indicating an improvement in WER as the model is fine-tuned over more epochs.
